comment: BastlPizza publishes no source. Seven of the seventeen parameters sit at the PITCH knob and three at the SHAPE knob: only the one the current mode calls for is visible, so each has its own line. Every input is read at channel 0 alone; the channels byte is read only to test whether a cable is present. The EXTERNAL input carries no family because what it means is whatever you patch into it — the module uses it as the modulator in place of the octave oscillator, so it can be audio or a control voltage. SYNC has no range field: it is passed to the sync oversampler unscaled and the threshold is inside Audio_pizza, which was not settled. The PULSE output is only computed when a cable is patched to it, and the envelope is applied to it in Ratio mode but not in Pulse mode.
